notes.title: Version 0.1.3 Update Released
notes.notes:
Version 0.1.3 Update Released

Update Details
- Adjusted the timing of Secretary's dialogue to trigger after stage completion.
- Removed unnecessary files.
- Bug fixes and adjustments.

From the Development Team
It has been a while.
We apologize for the lack of updates over the past few months.

About This Update
Previously, the Secretary's dialogue was optional and could be triggered on the stage selection screen. However, we have changed it so that it now always occurs after clearing a stage.
We made this change to place more focus on communication with the Secretary. Additionally, we plan to expand the variety of dialogues in future updates.

Upcoming Updates
We are planning the following updates in the near future:
 - New Character: Chief Nanosita

The character "Chief Nanosita", whose name has appeared occasionally in the story, will be officially introduced in the scenario.
She is scheduled to appear in post-clear dialogue scenes as well as in certain tutorial segments.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860975/90fe4fe06269e1f925bd147c6e5dfefb1b92dd87.png


Additionally, we are currently in the planning phase for a major overhaul of the Lab Screen.
We are considering changing the current simple level-up system to a skill tree system for a more engaging experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860975/29810046174ed822cf64160117721d02488db444.png
Please note that this feature is still under consideration. We will provide more details as development progresses.

Thank you for your continued support of Circular Defense!!
